title: Vallée on Ransone's NRO satellite work
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Vallée on Ransone's NRO satellite work, about late 1970s at Houston, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: An unnamed guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, in an episode about a CIA scientist said to have contacted an alien council, points to Forbidden Science, the published journals of UFO researcher Jacques Vallée. The guest says Vallée wrote of speaking with a woman named Valerie Ransone in Houston in the late 1970s, when she was doing some kind of work for the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites. The detail is told to tie her to the secret world of government intelligence.
